summary: High-energy results oriented Chief Information Officer offering global professional experience in managing complex information technology environments and cross-cultural teams while effectively aligning and supporting key company initiatives.

education.institution: University of Texas at El Paso

experience.title: Senior Vice President of Global Information Technology
responsibilities: Responsible for all aspects of Information Technology globally with a staff of 70 employees worldwide.
Eliminated high dependency on consulting firm supporting an ERP system globally, creating self-sufficiency and generating $2.5 million in annual savings.
Planned and delivered M&A integration projects, enabling anticipated benefits through system migration and technology integration.
Delivered a single global suite of applications with seamless integration, eliminating duplicity and streamlining business processes.
Introduced Project Life Cycle management system to Engineering and New Product Development teams, speeding product introduction.
Enabled effective analysis and decision making through improved analytical capabilities delivered in a single repository of reporting.
Formed the company's first IT Steering Committee for strategic planning and priority recommendations.
Deployed reliable, scalable, fault-tolerant technical infrastructure with maximum uptime and redundancy.
Provided high-performance, high-availability, and secure networks for global voice, data, and video communications.

experience.title: Director of Information Technology
responsibilities: Managed a large ERP implementation project and technical infrastructure operations for a distributor of DVD and VHS movies.
Led a staff of 20 IT professionals, implementing new technology and business applications.
Completed Oracle applications implementation on time after taking over a delayed project.
Restructured technical infrastructure to support the new ERP system across all US locations.
Led analysis, design, and deployment of web applications for real-time customer access.
Implemented wireless inventory control solution using RF devices.
Developed new technical support model and policies for processing support requests.
Hired and mentored IT personnel for post-production support of the ERP system.
Trained overseas personnel on Oracle application implementation and configuration.

experience.title: Practice Director
responsibilities: Managed projects ranging from $500K to $10M, achieving an average budget savings of 20%.
Coordinated a practice of 22 consultants.
Prepared RFP responses for large-scale implementation projects.
Performed full lifecycle project management for permanent employees and contractors.
Participated in business development of over $24M in new contracts at Oracle Corporation.
Completed large-scale implementations of Oracle's ERP suite for Fortune 100 clients.
Conducted functional and technical architecture assessments and provided solution designs.
Served as subject matter expert for Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Financial aspects.
Managed multi-national virtual teams and achieved project benchmarks ahead of schedule.

experience.title: Information Systems Director
responsibilities: Managed business applications and technical infrastructure operations for a 2,800-employee manufacturing and distribution company.
Negotiated contracts, directed long-range planning, and monitored budgets up to $8M.
Implemented Manufacturing and Financial systems domestically and overseas.
Implemented Oracle Financials, improving financial reporting accuracy and reducing past due accounts.
Implemented manufacturing applications at facilities in Monterrey, Mexico, improving supply chain performance.

experience.title: Information Systems Director
responsibilities: Supported corporate-wide projects in technology selection, delivery, and management.
Supervised fiscal responsibility, resource management, project management, and administrative detail.
Implemented MAPICS, enhancing supply chain capabilities.
Deployed new hardware and software architecture company-wide.
Implemented Electronic Data Interchange with preferred partners.
Implemented statistical performance measurements for productivity monitoring.

experience.title: Information Systems & Technology Manager
responsibilities: Managed systems design and development from business requirements analysis to day-to-day management.
Implemented MANMAN MRPII and RF-based inventory control solutions.
Developed new technical support model and policies.

experience.title: Systems Design & Development Lead
responsibilities: Performed systems design and development from business requirements analysis through day-to-day management.
